exposure: abnormal uterine artery Doppler velocimetry in the second trimester
cohort: The study included 116 asymptomatic patients who had abnormal uterine artery Doppler scans at gestational week 25.
finding: An sFlt-1/PlGF cutoff value greater than or equal to 38 improves its predictive power for adverse events in pregnancies with abnormal uterine artery Doppler in the second trimester.
gest_age: The cohort was identified at gestational week 25, with sFlt-1/PlGF ratio determined between weeks 25 to 29 of gestation.
